character_facts: Steelhead experiments with outward appearances by trying different helmets.
Steelhead's head is not ordinary; it is described as being made up of deadly weapons.
Steelhead is vain, theatrical, or image-conscious enough to solicit opinions on helmet style.
Steelhead is highly ambitious or self-important, reacting to the summons as if his moment has arrived.
Tonto is close enough to Steelhead to advise him and manage communications.
continuity_links: The page continues an ongoing political thread involving the imperial couple and the new Golden Palace.
Steelhead is already established enough that his unusual weapon-head anatomy and his assistant Tonto are presented without introduction.
dialogue_meaning: Steelhead is evaluating alternate helmet designs to hide or stylize his dangerous head.
Tonto serves as an assistant or attendant, offering blunt aesthetic judgment on the helmet options.
A high-level summons has arrived from the imperial court or palace.
Steelhead interprets the message as a major opportunity and immediately wants to respond.
locations: The new Golden Palace (mentioned as the transmission source)
lore_facts: The Metabunker can drift across the deserts of Sirtha.
Steelhead's head is composed of or includes deadly weapons, and helmets are used to mask that fact.
There is a place called the new Golden Palace.
The new Golden Palace can send galactic transmissions requesting audiences.
The page refers to the imperial couple as associated with the transmission or its broader context.
plot_events: A gruesome armored headpiece or helmet design is shown in close-up, emphasizing its bio-mechanical weapons components.
The narration states that the Metabunker is drifting across the deserts of Sirtha.
Steelhead is trying on costume helmets intended to conceal the deadly weapons that make up his head.
Steelhead asks Tonto for an opinion on one helmet design.
Tonto dismisses one design as overly poetic and better suited to someone else.
Tonto informs Steelhead that an urgent galactic transmission has arrived from the new Golden Palace requesting an audience.
Steelhead becomes eager, declares that he is needed, and orders Tonto to activate the holo-display.

visual_summary: A violent close-up shows a grotesque, weaponized head assembly being tested or fitted, with fleshy organic parts mixed into heavy armor and machinery. A caption situates the scene in the Metabunker drifting over the deserts of Sirtha. In the lower panels, Steelhead tries on stylized combat helmets while a small companion, Tonto, comments on them and relays an urgent galactic transmission from the new Golden Palace. Steelhead reacts excitedly and puts on a smooth reflective helmet, preparing to answer the summons.
